[[Frost Wurm]]s are colossal predators that infest some parts of the [[Shiverpeak Mountains]].  They lie in wait beneath the surface of the snow, striking at passing travelers with devastating necromantic spells.  An attack by a Frost Wurm is always preceded by sudden tremors in the ground. Their appearance will [[Knock Down|knock down]] anyone adjacent to them.
